title: PR #193: fix: correct copy-paste error in Address.company description
content:
## 🔧 Type of Change

- [ ] Documentation fix/improvement
- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] Tooling improvement
- [ ] Example update
- [ ] Minor data/enum addition

---

## 📝 Description

The `company` field in the `Address` schema has the description `"Postal or ZIP code"`, which was copied from the `postal_code` field directly above it. This corrects it to `"Company or organization name"`.

---

## 🎯 Motivation and Context

The incorrect description could mislead implementers into treating the `company` field as a postal code input rather than a company name.

---

## 🧪 Testing

- `pnpm run compile:schema` passes
- `pnpm run validate:all` passes with zero errors or warnings
- All three CI checks pass (Compile Schema, Validate Schemas and Consistency, PR title and description)

---

## 📸 Screenshots / Examples

Before:
```json
"company": {
  "type": "string",
  "description": "Postal or ZIP code"
}
```

After:
```json
"company": {
  "type": "string",
  "description": "Company or organization name"
}
```
